description: Makes the same photo again, a new take of the same look, paid from the user's credits. Pass the price the user agreed to as max_credits: the photo's prices from get_shoot or list_photos name it. When the user asks to re-roll the same photo once more, pass again: true. If a call to this tool got no answer, it may already have started: check list_photos before calling it again.

again.description: true only when the user, having seen what this same call made, asks for another (a second re-roll of one photo, another take of one shoot). Without it, the same call repeated within 10 minutes answers with what it made and charges nothing: a request already answered is not a new one.

name: reroll
title: Re-roll a photo
